results.title: Moving in time
results.overview: An apartment building in the east of the Netherlands, near the German border, is destined for demolition. It is the birthplace of the eccentric Henk, who, sixty years later, still lives there. If you desire nothing else, you are already living in paradise. Henk spends his days on a small stool in his kitchen, listening to pirate radio stations—music that transports him back to a bygone era. The building, once vibrant and defined by its post-war architecture, now stands deserted. As former residents revisit shared memories and reflect upon the past, Henk resists the inevitable.

results.title: The Secret of Hotel New York
results.original_title: Het Geheim van Hotel New York
results.overview: Few buildings tell the story of a city as vividly as Hotel New York does for Rotterdam. Originally constructed in 1901 as the headquarters of the Holland-America Line, this landmark building has witnessed over a century of commerce, migration, war, decline, and urban renewal. Drawing on a wealth of archival material and a diverse range of interviews, the film weaves together the personal accounts of those who knew the building from the inside with the historical evolution of Rotterdam as a port city. From an office building and squatted property to its eventual transformation into a hotel, "The Secret of Hotel New York" presents the story of an enduring symbol of Rotterdam’s capacity for reinvention.

results.title: Fight! Fight! Fight!
results.overview: Matthew Bowman is a lonely call center employee living an apathetic and confusing life. At work, his days consist of attempted cold call sales which are often met with rejection and a boss who’s superiority complex is unmatched. At home he finds himself lost in the infinite sea of ad campaigns on TV, featuring controversial politician Jimmy Joblinski.

results.title: The Making of The Shepherd’s Lamb
results.original_title: The Making of The Shepherd’s Lamb
results.overview: A documentary about the making of Ed' Morrow's hand-drawn debut feature film. Ed' reflects on three years of work on The Shepherd’s Lamb, looking back on how the project began, how its characters and visual identity developed, the challenges of learning animation while making the film, and the creative decisions that shaped the final cut.

results.title: Bilal Hassani, bats-toi comme une fille mon fils
results.original_title: Bilal Hassani, bats-toi comme une fille mon fils
results.overview: The general public discovered Bilal Hassani during Eurovision 2019 with his song "Roi" (King), a true anthem to diversity that sparked waves of both love and hatred on social media. Very quickly, the young man courageously tackled the question of gender identity in a personal and artistic exploration, not hesitating to share his doubts, his wounds, and his own evolution with us. This documentary sets out to embrace several deeply resonant themes: homosexuality, homophobia, cyberbullying and justice, racism as well as Moroccan roots, love and the choice of a mother who frees herself from cultural weight for her son's fulfillment, celebrity, and of course, identity and gender.

results.title: Good Time
results.overview: 'Good Time' follows Jaani, a young cab driver whose life is caught between love, gambling, and bad luck. As everything around him begins to fall apart, he keeps waiting for the one thing he believes will change his life: his Good Time.

results.title: Serdar Nalçakar: I've Turned Out All Right
results.original_title: Serdar Nalçakar: Bu Yaşıma İyi Geldim
results.overview: Retired Twitter troll and tax-paying comedian Serdar Nalçakar takes the stage for his solo stand-up show I've Turned Out All Right, tackling everything from social media misadventures and family dynamics to his days in Sweden and clashes with tribal traditions, all with his distinctive sense of humor.
